title: ManagedClusterAADProfile
description: Azure Active Directory configuration for integration with AKS.

enableAzureRBAC.description: Whether to enable Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorization.

adminGroupObjectIDs.description: The list of AAD group object IDs that will have admin role of the cluster.

clientAppID.description: (DEPRECATED) The client AAD application ID. Used for legacy/non-managed AAD.

serverAppID.description: (DEPRECATED) The server AAD application ID. Used for legacy/non-managed AAD.

serverAppSecret.description: (DEPRECATED) The server AAD application secret. Used for legacy/non-managed AAD.

tenantID.description: The AAD tenant ID to use for authentication. If not specified, will use the tenant of the deployment subscription.
